total_weight_is_zero.meaning: IVoter(voter).totalWeight() equals zero at the time notifyRewardAmount transfers rewards

pool_live_weight_is_zero.meaning: the pool's live weight equals zero when _updateForAfterDistribution runs

rewards_transferred.meaning: notifyRewardAmount transferred reward tokens into GaugeManager

stuck_emissions_recoverable_without_resc.meaning: the stuck emissions in GaugeManager can be recovered without a manual rescue

claims.scope: GaugeManager reward notification and per-pool distribution when total or pool weight is zero

preconditions.text: IVoter(voter).totalWeight() is zero when notifyRewardAmount transfers rewards.; A pool's live weight is zero when _updateForAfterDistribution runs.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Rewards transferred for an epoch should either be accruable by gauges or returned to the minter, not left permanently stranded in GaugeManager.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: The stuck emissions cannot be recovered without a manual rescue.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: notifyRewardAmount is the operation that transfers the epoch rewards into GaugeManager.
_updateForAfterDistribution is invoked for the pool after the reward transfer in the same distribution flow.
The stuck emissions are the reward tokens transferred by notifyRewardAmount that no gauge accrues.

limitations: The recoverability property is encoded as a report-grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric definition of recoverable versus unrecoverable amounts.
The plan formalizes only the unrecoverable_without_rescue impact; other listed impacts are not covered by this claim.
Whether the zero-weight scenario was observed live or is only conditional is not stated; the plan treats it as the report's stated scenario.
